requirement_summary: 멱등성, 재시도, 중복 이벤트 방어 (idempotency, retry, duplicate event defense).
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/IdempotencyStore.java (idempotency + duplicate-event defense), src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/BoundedRecoveryExecutor.java (retry), src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/LocalAuthenticatedApiServer.java (Idempotency-Key header wiring)
observed_source: IdempotencyStoreTest, BoundedRecoveryExecutorTest, LocalAuthenticatedApiServerTest (real JUnit execution and real HTTP responses)
coverage_notes: Idempotency: a repeated request under the same Idempotency-Key replays the cached response without re-executing (real duplicate-event defense) when the request body genuinely matches; a same-key request with a DIFFERENT body is rejected as a real conflict (409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUEST_MISMATCH), never silently treated as a replay -- closing the exact failure mode duplicate-event defense exists to prevent. Idempotency records persist across store instances (survives process restart) and are correctly scoped per tenant and per operation (no cross-tenant or cross-operation collision on a reused key). Retry: BoundedRecoveryExecutor retries a bounded number of times within a real budget and fails closed (rethrows, never swallows) once the budget is exhausted; an interruption propagates immediately without further retry attempts, and invalid budget parameters are rejected outright.
